What is AeroSentinel? AeroSentinel is an AI-powered research intelligence platform built for a specific thesis domain: “Prediction of Aerodynamic Heating on High-Speed Missiles Using Gaussian Process Based Surrogate Models.”
Every week, the system scans 7 top-tier academic databases for new publications, filters them through a multi-layer quality gate, classifies papers into core and peripheral research, and publishes curated bilingual intelligence briefings with structured analysis – all driven by a Telegram bot with one-tap approval.
Thesis Focus This platform is specifically tuned to track research at the intersection of:
Aerodynamic heating – prediction, measurement, and simulation of surface heat flux on high-speed vehicles AI/ML surrogates for CFD – Gaussian process regression, neural networks, deep learning, and physics-informed methods applied to aerodynamic and aerothermodynamic problems Hypersonic flow physics – boundary layer transition, shock-boundary layer interaction, real gas effects, stagnation point heating Papers directly on these topics get full individual deep-dive reviews (core papers). Everything else – broader CFD, general aerospace, scramjet propulsion, reentry physics – is synthesized into a flowing academic narrative with in-text citations (peripheral papers).
Sources Papers are sourced from 7 academic databases:
OpenAlex – broad academic coverage (200M+ works), with journal tier and institution filtering Crossref – 70M+ articles, DOI-based metadata, with thesis/dissertation discovery CORE – 200M+ open access articles, including theses and grey literature Semantic Scholar – citation velocity, influential citation counts, abstract enrichment arXiv – latest preprints, restricted to physics and computational categories with aerospace topic relevance check NASA NTRS – NASA technical reports and memoranda (always Tier 1) IEEE Xplore – IEEE conference and journal papers (optional, requires API key) Quality System Journal Tiers Tier 1 (always kept): AIAA Journal, Journal of Fluid Mechanics, Physics of Fluids, Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets, Aerospace Science and Technology, Shock Waves, and others Tier 2 (kept with citation velocity or elite institution): Computers & Fluids, Acta Astronautica, International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer, Chinese Journal of Aeronautics, and others Tier 0 (blocked, except theses/dissertations): unranked journals Scoring Papers are scored (0-100+) based on journal tier, source, keyword priority match, citation metrics, recency, and abstract availability. Only papers scoring 30+ are included. Papers scoring below 20 are discarded entirely.
Thesis Discovery Crossref dissertations and CORE theses bypass the tier-0 filter, enabling discovery of PhD and MSc work directly relevant to the thesis domain. These still pass through scoring, so irrelevant theses are naturally filtered out.
AI Analysis Each briefing is generated by Gemini 2.5 Flash and includes:
Two-tier structure – Core papers get full analysis (methodology, key findings, key numbers, limitations, cross-paper connections); peripheral papers are woven into a literature-review-style narrative 9 paper type classifications – ML/Heating, ML/Aerodynamics, ML/Transition, Numerical/CFD, Experimental, Analytical, Review, Multi-Method, Thesis 36 curated tags – Strict English-only vocabulary covering research domains, methodologies, physical phenomena, flow regimes, applications, and cross-cutting topics Relevance scoring (0-100) based on proximity to the thesis domain Critical analysis – Limitations field identifies methodological weaknesses and evidence strength Anti-slop filter – 24 banned AI filler phrases blocked in prompts and scrubbed from output Bilingual output – Every briefing in both English and Turkish Telegram Bot Control everything from Telegram:
Command Description /scout Trigger a paper hunt now /search Interactive custom search – pick from 36 tags, set date range /bibtex Export latest digest as BibTeX citations /bookmarks View your bookmarked digests /status Check latest workflow status /help Show available commands Draft previews arrive with one-tap Publish / Edit / Discard / Bookmark buttons.
Technical Details Fully automated – GitHub Actions runs the pipeline on schedule (weekly) or on demand via Telegram Open source – github.com/sezersivri/aerosentinel $0/month – GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Worker, Gemini API, Telegram Bot API, and all academic APIs are free tier Privacy first – No analytics, no tracking, no cookies Built with Hugo (PaperMod theme), Python 3.11, Cloudflare Workers, Gemini 2.5 Flash Current version: 2.4.0
